english.title: Destroy / damage / render inoperative / remove / otherwise interfere with scallop dredging tracking device - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), destroyed, damaged, rendered inoperative, removed or otherwise interfered with a tracking device installed for purposes of Article 3 of the Scallop Dredging Operations (Tracking Devices) (Wales) Order 2012
english.legislation: Contrary to article 7(3) of the Scallop Dredging Operations (Tracking Devices) (Wales) Order2012 and section 5(4) of the Sea Fisheries Act 1968.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See Article 3 of the Scallop Dredging Operations (Tracking Devices) (Wales) Order 2012 for the purposes of tracking devices being installed on scallop dredging boats.

other.penalty:
